timeline.description: R Mohan was arrested by the Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption for running a book scam. This scam involved the sale of thousands of bogus AI-generated book titles to state libraries. The investigation revealed glaring discrepancies, such as ghost writers and titles being registered under fictitious names. Additionally, many authors appeared in both of Mohan's proxy publications, further complicating the case.
